function.name: detect_beats_and_filter
function.description: Analyzes an audio file to detect beats and filters them based on confidence levels and timing. Returns a list of times in seconds, each representing the occurrence of a significant beat within the audio file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

capture_percentage.description: Filters beats by excluding those below a specified confidence percentile. Values range from 0 to 100 (inclusive).

confidence_window_size.description: Selects the highest confidence beat within a given time window in seconds (e.g., 0.5), to ensure distinct beats are chosen in that period. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user says "I dont want any beats". They likely want no beats detected. The tool can filter beats by excluding those below a capture_percentage threshold. If we set capture_percentage to 100, it will exclude all beats below 100% confidence. But if there are no beats at 100% confidence, we get none. Alternatively, we could set confidence_window_size to a very large number to only keep one beat per large window, but that still might return a beat. The user explicitly says they don't want any beats. So we should set capture_percentage to 100 to filter out all beats. Also we can set confidence_window_size to something like 0.1 or 0.5. But the main filter is capture_percentage. So we call the function with capture_percentage=100 and confidence_window_size=0.5.
